summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by PowerBank Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting a routine operational milestone for its Brooklyn community solar project in Nova Scotia. The filing announces the execution of a Standard Small Generator Interconnection and Operating Agreement (SSGIA) and receipt of municipal permits for a 6.86 MW solar project. It does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation. The press release describes standard project development progress, expected construction in Fall 2026, and projected community savings. No financial terms, board actions, or structural changes are disclosed. This is a routine current report on business operations.
